scope: Audit H3 final performance preset check: two candidate files from tools/fm3/h3-final-build.mjs, each loaded, read back, played with real guitar in all 8 scenes, stored by the user to 427, reloaded and read back. This replay performs no device I/O.

findings.final: V4 SATCH SOAP ON A ROPE V4 is accepted as the final performance preset: stored body byte-identical, no clipping, levels and sound fit in all 8 scenes, scene changes without a click; CPU 46.6-62.9%.
findings.v1: V1 LIVE KOOSLUS V1: data preserved after STORE (11 records, device record order), no clipping, clean scene changes; scene levels uneven (lead quietest, clean/Plexi loudest); not accepted as final.
findings.cpu: All 16 scene readings within 1 point of the fm3-cpu 0.2.5 estimate and within 0.5 points before/after STORE.
findings.switches: Scenes selected with an M-Wave MIDI footswitch (scenes 1-4); Ampero B is assigned to tap tempo/tuner (hold) and was not used for scenes.

limitations: Loudness is a user listening judgement; no numerical audio measurement.
Screenshots and CPU are FM3-Edit display, not the front panel.
Scenes were selected with an M-Wave MIDI footswitch for scenes 1-4; the FM3 footswitches and scenes 5-8 by footswitch were not checked.
